title: OrbitalAI - Orbital Operations Overview
description: Operational metrics for catalog coverage, deterministic conjunction screening and ingestion. No covariance or collision probability. Cached snapshots refresh every 60 seconds; unavailable collectors retain the last successful values.

panels.title: Platform and worker status
panels.description: 1 = healthy / successful, 0 = failed. Worker value is the last completed execution, not worker liveness. Database check is the existing /ready probe. Metrics refresh is 1 only when every cached collector's latest refresh succeeded.

panels.title: Eligible objects
panels.description: Current Earth-orbit canonical eligibility at the last catalog refresh; independent of a historical screening window.

panels.title: Last screening duration
panels.description: Service time; excludes database persistence.

panels.title: Conjunction events
panels.description: Threshold-connected encounter events from the last completed screening. No probability of collision is calculated.

panels.title: Catalog coverage
panels.description: Current-element flag does not imply fresh ephemerides. Canonical coverage counts objects with any latest canonical element across the full catalog.

panels.title: Earth-orbit ephemeris age
panels.description: Canonical Earth-orbit elements only. Future epochs are fresh, matching existing eligibility semantics. Refresh is at most once per 60 seconds.

panels.title: Conjunction pipeline reduction
panels.description: Chunk-unique counts are summed across chunks; they are not globally unique pairs. Raw counts include the shared overlap sample.

panels.title: Duplicate events suppressed
panels.description: Includes ordinary overlap solutions and continuous threshold episodes.

panels.title: Chunk count
panels.description: Sequential bounded-memory chunks. Their width is available as orbitalai_conjunction_last_run_chunk_seconds.

panels.title: Pipeline ratios
panels.description: Ratios are calculated in PromQL from the last completed run.

panels.title: Screening performance
panels.description: Histogram includes only runs observed since Step 6A was enabled. No historical backfill. Sparse jobs can leave the rate-based p95 empty.

panels.title: Execution counts in selected range
panels.description: Prometheus increase() is an estimate from scraped counters; sparse jobs need samples on both sides.

panels.title: Ingestion — time since successful sync
panels.description: No data means no successful sync observed since instrumentation was enabled. Historical success times are not invented.

panels.title: Ingestion — latest records and execution
panels.description: Records are from the last successful sync. Duration/outcome refer to the latest completed attempt. Imported means new SATCAT objects or new GP elements. Failure totals start when instrumentation is enabled.

panels.title: Catalog Synchronization
panels.description: Availability of the cached catalog synchronization telemetry snapshot. This is independent of provider freshness and process liveness.

panels.title: Last Successful Sync Age
panels.description: Elapsed time since each source last completed successfully. No data means no successful sync has been observed. Authoritative freshness classification remains in the API and health UI because cadence thresholds are configurable.

panels.title: Last Execution Status
panels.description: Outcome of the latest completed attempt for each source. Unknown means no completed execution has been observed.

panels.title: Consecutive Failures
panels.description: Consecutive failed attempts per source. A successful execution resets the value to zero.

panels.title: Last Sync Records
panels.description: Records reported by the latest completed catalog synchronization attempt for each source.

panels.title: Last Sync Duration
panels.description: Duration of the latest completed catalog synchronization attempt for each source.

panels.title: Firing Alerts
panels.description: Operational alerts firing in Prometheus. Direct Alertmanager smoke injections are not Prometheus ALERTS series.
